activity.notes: Otto I succeeded Henry I as king of the East Frankish/German realm in 936 and retained that kingship until his death on 7 May 973. ATLAS records this royal authority separately from his later Italian kingship and 962-973 imperial Activity.

sources.title: Otto I. — Deutsche Biographie
sources.citation_text: Deutsche Biographie identifies Otto I as German king from 936 and Roman emperor from 962 until his death in 973.

sources.title: The establishment of the Holy Roman Empire — Deutschlandmuseum
sources.citation_text: The Deutschlandmuseum describes Otto as elected King of East Francia before his imperial coronation in 962.
